Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
This is a petition seeking quashing of FIR No. 0350/2018 u/s 498A/406/34 IPC registered at PS Sarai Rohilla, Delhi dated 15.09.2018.
The parties have arrived at a settlement dated 24.06.2022, wherein the petitioner had to pay a sum of Rs. 10.8 lakhs to respondent No. 2.
Rs. 7.8 lakhs had already been paid and Rs. 3 lakhs has been paid today vide DD No. 366314 dated 09.03.2023 drawn on State Bank of India.
The petitioner is present in Court and is identified by Ms. Meena, Adv.
Respondent No. 2 is also present in Court and is identified by Mr. Shamindra Kadian, Adv. and IO S.K. Jha, PS Sarai Rohilla.
The parties state that they have arrived at the settlement out of their own free will, without any threat, pressure, coercion or undue influence.
It is stated that respondent No. 2 has no objection if the FIR is quashed.
There is no child born out of the wedlock.
For the aforesaid reasons, FIR No. 0350/2018 u/s 498A/406/34 IPC registered at PS Sarai Rohilla, Delhi dated 15.09.2018, is hereby quashed.
